sequence.description: Camera moves from the stained-glass threshold to the monumental bottle bar, then catches the cabinet loop and the darker north wing.
The token price board and TOKENS HERE arrow become readable before control returns.
Backpack Girl offers the rest of her kebab from her cabinet-side floor spot. Dialogue remains in her profile and Couchsurfing Chronicles.

prize_pool.name: Pre-Emptive Perry

poem: Perry searches near and far,
For hidden weapons in the jar.
He found no yellowcake today,
So now in Europe he will stay!

prize_pool.inspect_line: A camo bear whose plastic pellets feel suspiciously like depleted uranium.

prize_pool.name: Pets.con the Sock Hound

poem: Super Bowl ads cost a lot,
Now an empty parking lot.
Hug this dog with all your might,
His burn rate peaked on Tuesday night!

prize_pool.inspect_line: A plush sock puppet whose IPO valuation dropped ninety-eight percent before the stuffing settled.

prize_pool.name: Snorty the Bouncer Badger

poem: Snorty grinds his plushy jaws,
White residue on velvet paws.
Keep him away from bathroom stalls,
He’s pacing up and down the walls!

prize_pool.inspect_line: His snout has a permanent crust of baby laxative and unresolved nightclub hostility.

prize_pool.name: Mugshot Mandy

poem: Low-rise velour, no underwear,
Flashbulbs blinding in the air.
Lost her license, kept the fame,
Nobody can pronounce her name!

prize_pool.inspect_line: A Chihuahua whose rhinestone collar carries two active bench warrants and a sticky smear of lip gloss.

prize_pool.name: Minty the Rare Mint Bunny

poem: Keep my plastic tag attached,
A fortune waiting to be hatched.
Divorce courts had to split my fleece,
Three thousand SOVS for one piece!

prize_pool.inspect_line: Still trapped in a yellowed acrylic display cube with a sun-bleached Certificate of Authenticity.
